title: Derived module transition commutes with homology shift comparison
statement: For any ring Λ, triangle Y′ → Y → S, derived module sheaves K,K′, coefficient morphism v : D⁺a* K → K′, and integer q, the transition at the shifted objects followed by the degree-zero homology shift comparison equals the original comparison followed by degree-q homology of the transition. The canonical morphisms are those of def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions.

source.place: Tag 09Z1; canonical derived adjunction and shift comparisons

proof.text: Import all DerivedAdjunctionCommShift and apply its existing private generic theorem derivedUnit_commShift to each module-sheaf adjunction. Use Adjunction.CommShift.mk' to supply compatibility of the whole adjunction. No duplicate helper is declared.

Import all AbelianDerivedDirectImageTransitionShift and apply its existing private generic plusNatIso_commShift and plusCompIso_commShift to the exact pullback comparison. Apply its existing generic Adjunction.transitionThrough_shift to the two module-sheaf derived adjunctions. Expand the mate into lowerStarPlusTransition followed by the coefficient map.

Apply degree-zero homology to that equality. Naturality of isoShiftZero and shiftIso converts the shifted morphism into its degree-q homology; reassociate the composites. This is valid for every integer q, including zero and negative degrees.

theorem higherDirectImageTransition_homologyShift
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {Y Y' S : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (q : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (K' : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (v : D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K ⟶ K') :
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) 0).map
      (lowerStarPlusTransition Λ a h (a ≫ h) rfl (K⟦q⟧) ≫
        R+((a ≫ h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
          ((D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).commShiftIso q).hom.app K ≫
            (shiftFunctor _ q).map v)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).map
        ((R+((a ≫ h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).commShiftIso q).hom.app K') ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).isoShiftZero ℤ).inv.app
        ((R+((a ≫ h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K')⟦q⟧) ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).shiftIso q 0 q (add_zero q)).hom.app
        (R+((a ≫ h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K') =
    ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).map
        ((R+((h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).commShiftIso q).hom.app K) ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).isoShiftZero ℤ).inv.app
        ((R+((h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K)⟦q⟧) ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ 0).shiftIso q 0 q (add_zero q)).hom.app
        (R+((h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
        (lowerStarPlusTransition Λ a h (a ≫ h) rfl K ≫
          R+((a ≫ h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map v)
